name: scratch-guard
description: PreToolUse hook that blocks scratch/test scripts from being materialized as standalone files in a shared system temp directory (/tmp, /private/tmp, /var/folders) outside a Claude Code session's own scratchpad subdirectory — either because the file looks executable (.sh/.py/etc.) or because its content embeds a base64 decode-into-exec pattern, both of which read as obfuscation to endpoint security. Plain non-executable drafts (e.g. the dm-pbcopy workflow's /tmp/<name>.txt files) are left alone.
